import os
fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='adrian_burt@gmail.com', password=[x for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]['password'])['access_token']
spots_subdirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
spots = [os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(p)) for p in spots_subdirs]
zip_targets = [f"~/pictures/vacations/{s}.zip" for s in spots]
print('spots_subdirs:', spots_subdirs)
print('zip_targets:', zip_targets)
results=[]
for d, zp, s in zip(spots_subdirs, zip_targets, spots):
    r = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=d, access_token=fs_token, compressed_file_path=zp, delete_directory=True, overwrite=False)
    results.append((s, r))
print('compress_results:')
for s, r in results:
    print(s, r)
# Verify remaining vacation spot sub-directories
remaining = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/pictures/vacations/', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
print('remaining_subdirs:', remaining)
